units.source_text: 入山修行的朱雀院闻知三公主平安分娩，不胜庆喜，却又十分挂念。

en.t: Suzaku-in, who had gone into the mountains for religious practice, was overjoyed to hear that the Third Princess had given birth safely, yet he was also deeply worried.

units.source_text: 听说她身子一直不好，不知究竟如何，左思右想，诵经念佛也不得专心了。

en.t: When he heard that her health had remained poor, he wondered anxiously how she truly was, and he could no longer concentrate even on reciting sutras and prayers.

units.source_text: 三公主身体如此衰弱，加之连日饮食不进，竟濒于危险状态了。

en.t: The Third Princess was so weakened, and since she had taken almost no food for days, she had at last reached a dangerous condition.

units.source_text: 她对源氏说：“我年来一直思慕父亲，此刻更加想念得厉害了。

en.t: She said to Genji, "For years I have longed for my father, and now I miss him more intensely than ever.

units.source_text: 难道此生不得再见了么？”

en.t: Can it be that I will never see him again in this life?"

units.source_text: 说罢放声大哭。

en.t: After saying this, she burst into loud sobs.

units.source_text: 源氏便派一适当人员到朱雀院去，将三公主情状如实奏闻。

en.t: Genji then sent a suitable messenger to Suzaku-in to report the Third Princess's condition exactly as it was.

units.source_text: 朱雀院闻讯，悲痛不堪，顾不得出家人规例，就在当夜悄悄地前来探望。

en.t: When Suzaku-in heard the news, he was overcome with grief and, disregarding the rules of one who had taken vows, came quietly that very night to visit her.

units.source_text: 并无预先通知，突如其来驾临，使得源氏吃了一惊，惶恐万状。

en.t: Because there had been no advance notice and the visit was sudden, Genji was startled and filled with alarm and reverence.

units.source_text: 朱雀院对他说道：“我对世俗之事，早已忘怀一切。

en.t: Suzaku-in said to him, "I had long since put all worldly matters out of mind.

units.source_text: 然而心中尚有惑乱，便是爱子之心执迷不悟。

en.t: Yet one confusion still remains in my heart: my stubborn attachment of love for my child.

units.source_text: 因此闻讯之后，修行也懈怠了。

en.t: Because of this, after hearing the news, even my religious practice grew slack.

units.source_text: 倘若死之先后不按老幼顺序，而她先我而死，则此恨绵绵，永无绝期。

en.t: If death does not follow the order of age, and she dies before I do, this sorrow will stretch on without end.

units.source_text: 为此不顾世人讥议，夤夜匆匆来此。”

en.t: For that reason, heedless of what people may say, I hurried here in the depth of night."

units.source_text: 朱雀院虽然改了装束，神情照旧清秀。

en.t: Although Suzaku-in had changed his attire, his expression was still as refined and beautiful as before.

units.source_text: 为欲避免外人注目，不穿正式法衣，只着一件墨色便服，然而姿态清丽可爱，使得源氏不胜羡慕，一见了他，又像往常那样掉下泪来。

en.t: To avoid attracting attention, he did not wear formal priestly robes but only a dark plain garment; still, his bearing was so pure, graceful, and lovely that Genji felt overwhelming admiration, and at the sight of him tears fell as they always had.

units.source_text: 对朱雀院说道：“公主病状并不严重，只因几月以来，一直衰弱，加之饮食不进，以致积累成疾耳。”

en.t: He said to Suzaku-in, "The Princess's illness is not grave in itself; she has simply been weak for several months, and because she has not been eating, the condition has accumulated into sickness."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“草草设席，乞恕不恭！”

en.t: Then he added, "Please forgive this hastily prepared and inadequate reception."

units.source_text: 便在三公主帷屏前设个茵褥，引导朱雀院进去就座。

en.t: He placed a cushion before the Third Princess's curtain screen and guided Suzaku-in inside to sit down.

units.source_text: 众侍女连忙扶三公主起身，下床迎候。

en.t: The waiting women hurriedly helped the Third Princess rise and brought her down from her bed to receive him.

units.source_text: 朱雀院将帷屏略略撩起，对她说道：“我这模样很像个守夜的祈祷僧，然而修行功夫未深，煞是惭愧！

en.t: Suzaku-in lifted the curtain screen slightly and said to her, "In this appearance I look rather like a night-watch prayer monk, yet my practice is still shallow, which shames me greatly.

units.source_text: 只因挂念于你，教你看看我的模样。”

en.t: It is only because I was worried about you that I have let you see me like this."

units.source_text: 便伸手拭泪。

en.t: Then he reached out his hand and wiped away his tears.

units.source_text: 三公主哭泣着，以非常微弱的声音答道：“女儿已无生望，父皇今日枉驾，就请顺便剃度我为尼僧吧。”

en.t: The Third Princess answered through her tears in an extremely faint voice, "Your daughter has no hope of living. Since Father has kindly come today, please take this chance to tonsure me as a nun."

units.source_text: 朱雀院答道：“你能有此大愿，诚属可贵。

en.t: Suzaku-in replied, "That you can hold such a great aspiration is truly admirable.

units.source_text: 但虽患大病，未必竟无生望。

en.t: But even with a serious illness, it does not necessarily mean that there is no hope of life.

units.source_text: 况且你年纪轻轻，来日方长，此时出家，将来反多烦累，招致世人讥议。

en.t: Besides, you are still young and have many days ahead; if you take vows now, it may bring more burdens later and invite criticism from the world.

units.source_text: 还望三思为是。”

en.t: I hope you will think it over very carefully."

units.source_text: 又对源氏说道：“她发此心，出于自愿。

en.t: He then said to Genji, "This resolve of hers comes from her own will.

units.source_text: 病势若果沉重，我想让她出家，即使片刻，也可蒙受佛力赐助。”

en.t: If her illness is truly grave, I would like to let her take vows, so that even for a moment she may receive the aid of the Buddha's power."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“她近日常说这话，但闻人言，此乃邪魔欺骗病人，唆使发心出家，请勿听信为是。”

en.t: Genji said, "She has often said this recently, but I have heard people say that evil spirits deceive the sick and urge them to take vows, so please do not believe it."

units.source_text: 朱雀院说：“若是鬼怪唆使，听信了是不好的，原也应该慎重；但现在这病人如此衰弱，自知无望而作此最后请求，如果置之不理，深恐后悔莫及。”

en.t: Suzaku-in said, "If it is a spirit urging her on, it would be wrong to believe it, and of course we should be cautious; but now this sick woman is so weak, and knowing she has no hope, she makes this final request. If we ignore it, I fear we may regret it beyond repair."

units.source_text: 此时他心中想道：“我当初把女儿托付与他，以为最可放心。

en.t: At that moment he thought to himself, "When I first entrusted my daughter to him, I believed it was the safest choice.

units.source_text: 岂知他接受之后，对她怜爱并不深切，殊非我所期望。

en.t: Who could have known that after accepting her, his affection for her would not be deep, so far from what I had hoped.

units.source_text: 此种情况，年来时有所闻，使我不胜挂念。

en.t: Over the years I have heard such things from time to time, and they have troubled me deeply.

units.source_text: 公然口出恨言，则又有所未便；而任世人猜度议论，实在教人伤心。

en.t: It would be improper to speak open words of resentment, yet letting the world speculate and gossip is truly heartbreaking.

units.source_text: 我为此烦恼到今日了。

en.t: I have been distressed over this until today.

units.source_text: 还不如乘此机会，让她出家当了尼姑，教世人知道她不是为了夫妇不睦而出家的，就不致受人讥笑。

en.t: It would be better to use this occasion to let her take vows and become a nun, so that people will know she did not renounce the world because of marital discord, and she will not be mocked.

units.source_text: 此后源氏对她虽无夫妇关系，但一般的照顾还可和从前一样。

en.t: After that, even if Genji no longer has a marital relationship with her, ordinary care for her can remain as before.

units.source_text: 只此一点就算是我把女儿托付与他的最后要求吧。

en.t: Let this one point be counted as my final request after entrusting my daughter to him.

units.source_text: 只要不是怀恨而出家的就好。

en.t: It will be enough as long as she is not taking vows out of resentment.

units.source_text: 我可把桐壶父皇所赐的广厦华宇加以修缮，供她居住。

en.t: I can repair the spacious and splendid residence granted by my father, Emperor Kiritsubo, and provide it for her to live in.

units.source_text: 她虽然当了尼姑，但我在住世期间，必可多方照顾，教她安乐无忧。

en.t: Although she becomes a nun, while I remain in this world I can surely care for her in many ways and let her live peacefully without worry.

units.source_text: 源氏对她，夫妇之爱虽然冷淡，总不会十分疏略而抛弃她。

en.t: Though Genji's conjugal love for her is cold, surely he would not neglect her so badly as to abandon her.

units.source_text: 这点心情我总可以料到的。”

en.t: At least that much of his feeling I can surely understand."

units.source_text: 便又说道：“那么，我既已来了，就让她受了戒，结点佛缘吧。”

en.t: Then he said again, "In that case, since I have come, let her receive the precepts and form some bond with the Buddha."

units.source_text: 源氏忘记了对三公主的怨恨，但觉可悲可悯，心中想道：“这究竟是怎么一回事啊！”

en.t: Genji forgot his resentment toward the Third Princess and felt only sadness and pity, thinking to himself, "What on earth is happening?"

units.source_text: 他忍耐不住，便走进帷屏里面去，对三公主说道：“你为什么抛弃我这余命无多的人而发心出家呢？

en.t: Unable to endure it, he went inside the curtain screen and said to the Third Princess, "Why do you wish to take vows and abandon me, a man with little life remaining?

units.source_text: 还是暂且镇静些，吃点汤药，进点饮食吧。

en.t: For now, please calm yourself a little, drink some medicinal broth, and take a little food.

units.source_text: 出家虽是尊严之事，但你身体如此衰弱，怎么禁得住修持之劳呢？

en.t: Taking vows is certainly a solemn thing, but with your body so weakened, how could you endure the hardships of religious practice?

units.source_text: 总之，保养身体为要。”

en.t: In any case, caring for your body is what matters most."

units.source_text: 三公主只是摇头，她觉得他现在说这些好话，反而可恨。

en.t: The Third Princess merely shook her head; now that he was saying such kind words, she found them all the more hateful.

units.source_text: 源氏察看出：她平日虽无表示，心中其实怀恨。

en.t: Genji perceived that although she had never shown it openly, in her heart she had in fact been resentful.

units.source_text: 便觉得她很可怜。

en.t: This made him feel great pity for her.

units.source_text: 如此一方反对，一方踌躇不决，说说谈谈之间，不觉天色将晓了。

en.t: Thus, with one side opposing and the other hesitating in indecision, they talked back and forth until, before they knew it, dawn was about to break.
